Zapier is one of the most comprehensive automation tools available, and it’s a top choice for small and large businesses alike. Its automations are easy to use, and its versatile design makes it suitable for all industries.

Zapier allows you to eliminate the tasks you find yourself doing again and again by setting up automations. By connecting Jotform to integrated apps and software, you can make Jotform a marketing automation tool. You can customize autoresponder emails, create dynamic documents that change depending on a user’s form submission and responses, and more.
